main_body: Wide steampunk workshop: a large sloped corrugated-metal roof (rows 47-91) over a brick front wall with arched windows and a riveted double door (rows 92-135), plus a brick chimney
top_band: Roof slope at x=80: light grey-blue rows 49-51 (L158/122), a dark vent strip 53-58, light roof again 59-63, then mid and dark grey down to row 91. It reads as one large sloped surface, with an orange eave line at row 92
evidence: The roof is a big foreshortened slope seen from above. It darkens toward the eaves and carries a skylight band, dormer windows and a rooftop vent. An orange eave trim (row 92) with a dark row under it (rows 93-94) marks the front edge and eave shadow. The brick wall below has inset arched windows with sills and a framed door, so it is a proper 3/4 building like the reference houses, not a flat elevation.

style.evidence: The measured facts show 36 distinct colours against 66 and 185 for the references. Median colours per tile are 9, against 11 and 18. 89% of dark edge pixels are neutral, against 7-9% for the references, so the outline is a near-black sticker line rather than the dark tone of the adjacent material. The roof has only about 4-5 grey steps, mostly vertical stripes with sparse rust dots. It is cleanly drawn but thinner and less tinted than the references, so it fails on the outline and density measures.
